name: Penpot
description: Read and edit the focused page of an open Penpot design file through the hosted MCP server.

methods.whenToUse: Use the complete Penpot-generated MCP URL that already includes your userToken.
methods.guidanceMd: In Penpot, open Your account → Integrations → MCP Server, enable MCP, create a key if needed, and copy the server URL that already includes your MCP key as userToken. Paste that complete URL here. Then open a design file and choose File → MCP Server → Connect on the tab that should stay active.
methods.label: Paste generated MCP URL
warnings: The pasted URL is the secret; treat it like an API key and do not share it in chats or screenshots.
Calls hit only the focused page of the connected Penpot tab; keep File → MCP Server → Connect active on that tab.
Remote mode cannot import local images or export shapes to local file paths.

agentInstructions.text: Penpot MCP tools operate only on the currently focused page in the connected browser tab. Keep File → MCP Server → Connect active on that tab while working. Start with a read such as high_level_overview (or another inspect/list/export tool) before proposing edits. Describe intended design changes before applying them, and prefer small reversible steps. Treat execute_code as a mutation that needs approval. Remote mode cannot import local images or export shapes to local file paths. Do not ask the operator to re-share the secret-bearing server URL.
